dedupeText: 90s urban streetwear portrait 90s hip hop streetwear overalls headband bold typography red and navy urban fashion portrait photography red headband and t shirt create a vertical color connection through the center navy overalls act as a heavy visual anchor in the lower half of the frame the boxed typography in the upper right balances the script typography in the lower left combine a high saturation urban portrait with a dual font system one boxed geometric sans serif for the name and one outlined script for the title using a primary red and navy palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a woman in 1990s urban streetwear, featuring a high-contrast color palette of vibrant red and deep navy blue against a clean white background. The subject wears a red t-shirt, navy overalls, and a red headband, positioned centrally with a confident, direct gaze. The layout is framed by bold, blocky display type in the upper right and elegant script in the lower left.
coreVisualRelationships: Red headband and t-shirt create a vertical color connection through the center.
Navy overalls act as a heavy visual anchor in the lower half of the frame.
The boxed typography in the upper right balances the script typography in the lower left.
coreInvariants: High-saturation primary red and navy blue color scheme.
Flat, bright studio lighting with minimal shadows.
Subject's direct eye contact and hands-on-hips posture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large navy blue bib of the overalls serves as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves up to the boxed header, then follows the line of the arms down to the script text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white background provides high contrast and allows the bold colors to pop.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a high-value white background for maximum impact.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly red, navy, white, and black.

letterConstructionRules: Header text uses thick, uniform strokes with rounded corners.
Footer text uses high-contrast thick-to-thin strokes with sharp serifs and decorative flourishes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Header letters are enclosed in a double-bordered rectangular frame.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast juxtaposition between a rigid, boxed sans-serif and a fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Double-lined rectangular frame for the header.
Staggered text placement for the subtitle.

preserve: The boxed enclosure for the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky feel of the header.
Captures the elegant, high-contrast script style of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with black hair in a bob, wearing a red headband, a red t-shirt, and navy blue overalls, standing against a plain white background with hands on hips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red uppercase sans-serif name in a navy-bordered box in the top right. Add a red script title with white outlines in a staggered three-line layout in the bottom left, overlapping the navy overalls.

verificationChecks: Is the red vibrant and the navy deep?
Is the top text enclosed in a distinct navy box?
Does the script text have a visible white outline against the navy background?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the header box border
mustRedesign: Exact brand markings on the headband
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red of the text matches the red of the clothing.
Check that the script text is legible against the dark overalls.
Verify the white background is pure and free of gradients.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation urban portrait with a dual-font system: one boxed geometric sans-serif for the name and one outlined script for the title, using a primary red and navy palette.
